brief: Taha is a cleaning operations management platform for the Austrian market. Slogan: SCHNELL & SAUBER. Three-tier architecture: owner app (full management), worker app (lightweight employee interface), client app (QR-accessible service requests). Stack: Vite + React + TypeScript + Supabase PostgreSQL. Features: employee scheduling, attendance clock in/out, payroll calculation, inventory management, expense tracking, service requests. i18n: German (default) / English. Design: green / lemon-green / black.

prd.overview: Cleaning operations app for one Austrian cleaning company. Trial product.
goals: Manager runs entire business from one app
Customer requests handled via QR code scan
success_metrics: Zero missed shifts due to schedule confusion
Shift reassigned within 5 minutes on sick call
Payroll prep under 15 minutes per week
No cleaning cancelled due to missing supplies

tech_spec.backend: Supabase (PostgreSQL 17, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime)
tech_spec.database: PostgreSQL via mcp-postgres — 17 tables, RLS per role, payroll RPC
tech_spec.auth: Supabase Auth phone OTP → JWT with app_role claim (owner/employee/customer)
tech_spec.storage: Supabase Storage — taha-receipts, taha-buildings, taha-payroll, taha-public
tech_spec.realtime: Supabase Realtime channels for schedule change broadcast
tech_spec.notifications: Supabase Edge Functions triggered by DB webhooks → push/SMS
tech_spec.deployment: Vercel (client public, owner/worker private) via mcp-vercel

mcp_usage.mcp-postgres: Schema migrations, payroll RPC, RLS validation
mcp_usage.mcp-auth: JWT role injection, employee account provisioning
mcp_usage.mcp-storage: Receipt uploads, QR code generation and storage
mcp_usage.mcp-notifications: Emergency schedule change alerts, low stock alerts
mcp_usage.mcp-analytics: Shift completion events, attendance events, expense events
mcp_usage.mcp-vercel: Production deployment of all three apps
mcp_usage.mcp-monitor: Uptime monitoring for client app public URL
mcp_usage.mcp-git-ops: Commit and push workflow from Claude Code
mcp_usage.mcp-test-runner: 7 validation story tests, RLS security tests
mcp_usage.mcp-env: Manage VITE_SUPABASE_URL and VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY across apps
mcp_usage.mcp-scaffold: Should have been used to create the repo structure — use for v0.2

user_stories: As manager, I create the weekly schedule every Sunday so employees see shifts instantly
As manager, I reassign a sick employee in under 5 minutes and the replacement is notified
As employee, I clock in at the building and clock out when done — no manual timesheet
As manager, I review auto-calculated payroll on Friday and export in under 15 minutes
As employee, I see today's special tasks and mark them complete after each shift
As employee, I report low bleach stock and the manager sees it immediately
As customer, I scan a QR code, fill a form, and request a cleaning in under 2 minutes
As manager, I send a payslip to each employee and they sign it digitally to confirm receipt
wireframe_spec: Three-app PWA. Owner: sidebar nav desktop, bottom tabs mobile. Worker: 3-tab bottom nav. Client: single flow cards.
style_guide: Dark theme. Green/lemon-green primary actions. Black background. DM Sans type. Mobile-first.

pre_build.note: Taha registered post-build. Schema deployed, apps running, Supabase connected.
